collectionTaskStateMachine.scope: organization and workspace scoped task, subquery, attempt, event, outbox and dead-letter truth in MySQL 5.7
collectionTaskStateMachine.retryPolicy: maximum 4 total attempts; 1, 5 and 15 minute backoff plus at most 20 percent jitter; rate limit uses reset time
collectionTaskStateMachine.credentialRenewalReplay: validated credential rotation preserves the blocked task history; active browser work is requeued in place, while blocked_login and historic login-misclassified empty or warning terminal tasks are marked automatically_replayed and cloned as a new scheduled task

collectionTaskStateMachine.permission: authenticated platform collection:replay; same-origin Origin, Idempotency-Key and reason for dead-letter replay
collectionTaskStateMachine.responseBoundary: task status, coverage, scoped counts, subqueries, attempts, events, dead-letter and correlation; no target_json, lease token or credential

collectionTaskStateMachine.runtimeBoundary: engine and synthetic live verification only; real Provider executor starts at M03-07 and evidence persistence starts at M03-06
collectionTaskStateMachine.liveVerificationClock: execution-time current clock; historical fixed timestamps are forbidden because the production Worker must not recover a newly-created verification lease as expired
